rv.q: It could prove to be one of the most influential theatre works of the century
JK Rowling, Jack Thorne, and John Tiffany have created a theatre production of immense wonder, one that is highly referential to Harry Potter stories past and is, above all, truly magical.
The big news is that this is just what was needed, will raise the benchmark for family entertainment for years to come and may even usher in a whole cycle of Potter-world stories.
For the legions of Pottermaniacs eager to be reunited with the characters they adore, this will be a magical experience.
The result, delivered in two parts, is thrilling: gripping, dark, wittily acted and often visually dazzling.
I would cheerfully sacrifice some plot and pyrotechnics for richer characterisation, psychological depth, more emotional involvement.

Harry Potter fans, you will be glad to know that JK Rowling, Jack Thorne, and John Tiffany have created a theatre production of immense wonder, one that is highly referential to Harry Potter stories past and is, above all, truly magical.
Tiffany and his team stage the piece with such dazzling assurance that I finally began to see the point of being wild about Harry.
The West End’s ornate Palace Theatre, itself a little like Hogwarts, has a hit probably for years.
Gripping, poignant and, at times, chilling – put it on your ‘must watch'
This story is meant to be witnessed on stage.
You can just sit back and enjoy the ride.

cn.t: Critics hail this theatrical spectacle as a thrilling, visually dazzling triumph packed with enchantment and stunning special effects, though its epic length and dense Potter lore may challenge non-devotees.

lo.inst: Draws Friday at 1 PM on the TodayTix app. Lottery includes tickets for full-length Pt I and II on same day. After September 20, 2026 will be a condensed one-part show. Open Run.
